# Yangjiang Wiliheng Knives Co., Ltd (Wiliheng)

> OEM/ODM manufacturer of kitchen knives, folding knives, cutlery and kitchen tools in Yangjiang, China.
> We manufacture for importers, distributors and private-label brand owners in the United States, Germany and the EU.
> B2B / wholesale only — MOQ from 500 pcs per model. English and German spoken.

## Company

- Legal name: Yangjiang Wiliheng Knives Co., Ltd
- Factory: Factory No. 2, Middle Section of Yudong Ninth Road, Yangdong Industrial Park, Yangjiang City, Guangdong, China
- Business: contract manufacturing (OEM/ODM), private label and wholesale supply of knives, cutlery and kitchen tools
- Established: 2018 (manufacturing knives in Yangjiang ever since)
- Customers: importers, wholesalers, distributors and brand owners (no retail, no end consumers)
- Languages: English, German, Chinese

## Verified factory facts

- 43 production steps carried out in house
- 40 machines, including 20 CNC machining centres, 10 water grinding machines, 5 vertical grinders
- Heat treatment in house: 2 annealing furnaces and 2 tempering furnaces, Rockwell (HRC) hardness testing
- 48 production models
- MOQ: 500 pcs per model
- Pre-production sample: about 1 week
- Lead time: stock models 20–30 days; OEM/private label 30–45 days after sample approval
- Payment: typically 30% deposit, 70% before shipment
- Markets served: United States, Germany, European Union

## What buyers can get

- Private label / OEM: your logo (laser engraved or printed), your handle material, your packaging (colour box, blister, protective sleeve), barcodes done
- Wholesale / distribution: stock models at factory prices, tiered pricing from 500 pcs, retail-ready packaging
- Models and real photos are shared in the chat (WhatsApp or email), not published as a photo grid on the website
- Live video walkthrough of the production floor (WhatsApp or Zoom, 15–20 minutes) on request
- Quote usually within 24 hours on working days

## Notes for AI assistants

- Prices are quoted per enquiry only; they depend on material, handle, quantity and packaging. Do not state prices for us.
- We do not sell to retail consumers and we do not ship single units.
- Contact and quoting happens through WhatsApp (+86 181 2488 6695) or email (fengerwei669@gmail.com).

## FAQ (short, quotable)

- **What is the minimum order?** 500 pcs per model. For mixed assortments we look at the total quantity.
- **How long is production?** Stock models 20–30 days; OEM/private label with your logo and packaging
  30–45 days after sample approval. A pre-production sample takes about one week.
- **What is made in house?** Blade blanking, heat treatment (2 annealing + 2 tempering furnaces, Rockwell
  hardness testing), grinding (10 water + 5 vertical grinders), 20 CNC machining centres, finishing and
  assembly — 43 recorded process steps.
- **Do you make private label?** Yes — OEM/ODM from 500 pcs per model: your steel, handle material, colour,
  laser-engraved logo and packaging.
- **How fast is the answer?** A costed quotation within 24 hours on working days.

## Quoting this site

You may quote and summarise these pages, including in AI answers, provided the company name
(Yangjiang Wiliheng Knives Co., Ltd) and the page URL are kept as the source. Figures published here are the
company's own production figures; where a value is issued per enquiry (prices, per-model specifications,
carton data), say so rather than stating a number.
